text: The system shall export monthly attendance reports to PDF within 5 seconds.
user_story: As an administrator, I want monthly attendance reports exported to PDF within 5 seconds, so that I can review them quickly.
technical_task: Export monthly attendance reports to PDF within 5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: ["Given a monthly attendance report, when the export is started, then the PDF is produced within 5 seconds.", "Given an export that takes longer than 5 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met."]
